title: OpenAI is shutting down Atlas, but its AI browser ambitions are still growing
slides: OpenAI killed Atlas—so why expand browsing features?
The browser was quietly integrated into ChatGPT's search.
But Atlas’s code now powers new agent-based web tools.
Your search queries will soon trigger autonomous AI actions.
Test the new search switch today—ignore at your cost.
thread_text:
1. OpenAI killed Atlas

They absorbed its core tech while sunsetting the product. The browsing feature you see now is built on that graveyard.

2. The search is alive

Quietly, ChatGPT’s search integrated Atlas’s browser. No announcement—just a new tab in your interface.

3. Code powers new agents

Atlas’s engine now runs autonomous web tools. Your prompts will soon trigger actions beyond simple answers.

4. Your queries go autonomous

Search will execute multi-step tasks on its own. From fetching data to filling forms—AI acts for you.

5. Test the switch today

Open ChatGPT, flip the search toggle, and run a live query. Ignore it and watch competitors leap ahead.
